acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance binds test identity to content (file blob plus test id), and a changed test loses its acceptance.
A focused test covers rename and edit.
body: Residual from lane cce2-1022u (PR beamfall/corvint#1553, seal 751a2a15d). Accepted CCE outcomes are keyed by test name only and carry no signature or content binding, so a renamed or edited test can inherit an earlier acceptance.
title: CCE acceptance identity is name-based and unsigned
